package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for no_streaming_for_large_export_handler: Large export handlers that materialize everything before writing.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: gin; severity: contextual.

type ExportRecord struct {
	ID        int    `json:"id"`
	Name      string `json:"name"`
	Status    string `json:"status"`
	CreatedAt string `json:"created_at"`
}

func scenario330Positive(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	records := fetchAllRecords()

	payload := make([]ExportRecord, 0, len(records))
	for _, rec := range records {
		payload = append(payload, ExportRecord{
			ID:        rec.ID,
			Name:      rec.Name,
			Status:    rec.Status,
			CreatedAt: rec.CreatedAt,
		})
	}

	body, err := json.Marshal(payload)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "encoding failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.Write(body)
}

type dbRecord struct {
	ID        int
	Name      string
	Status    string
	CreatedAt string
}

func fetchAllRecords() []dbRecord {
	result := make([]dbRecord, 0, 1000)
	for i := 0; i < 1000; i++ {
		result = append(result, dbRecord{
			ID:        i,
			Name:      fmt.Sprintf("item-%d", i),
			Status:    "active",
			CreatedAt: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z",
		})
	}
	return result
}
